action_instruction: Reading the actual risk from the Result panel
intent: the actual risk shown in the Result panel

action_params.condition: the actual risk shown is exactly $7.50
action_params.query: the actual risk shown in the Result panel

action_instruction: Checking the actual risk against the risk budget
intent: whether the actual risk is within the risk budget calculated from the account balance and Risk per trade field

action_params.condition: the actual risk shown is not greater than the risk budget the page shows under the "Risk per trade" field (balance 2500 multiplied by 0.3% is $7.50 rounded to the cent)
action_params.query: whether the actual risk is within the risk budget calculated from the account balance and Risk per trade field
action_params.code_js: (() => { const actual = parseFloat((el(29) ? Array.from(el(29).querySelectorAll('dt')).find(x => x.textContent.trim() === 'Actual risk')?.nextElementSibling?.textContent : '')?.replace(/[^0-9.]/g, '')); const balance = parseFloat(el(8)?.value); const percent = parseFloat(el(10)?.value); return Number.isFinite(actual) && Number.isFinite(balance) && Number.isFinite(percent) ? actual <= balance * percent / 100 : null; })()
